about: Batch 5 (3 Nov 2026). Built on batch 4 (reports/greyhound_model.md section 21): a learning rate of 0.05 and the weigh-in each helped call the move to the SP; the first-bend and style-draw blocks did not on their own at 0.08. Here: the two together, with and without the blocks, the slower rate given more rounds; and the best of them through the limit-order study (section 22) in the slow lane, so the early-lay leads are read on a better price than the 5 Oct model's.
